_file: damned_waters/game/data/rooms/kalverstraat.json — RoomSpec for Kalverstraat (the city, district 5: the Kalverstraat): the Kalverstraat, the city's busiest shopping street, from the Dam south to the Singel: shop after shop, most with their shutters down, garlands of lights still strung across it; a gun shop, a chemist's, a jeweller's put in by looters; the alley through to Muntplein near its end. Modelled after openly licensed photographs; every business name is made up, the landmarks keep theirs. The power is still on; nobody is there. Outdoor (street.py, city.py and landmarks.py build it). Single source of truth for Blender (render) and the engine (collision, cameras, things).

interactables.text: Shutter after shutter, all the way down. On one, sprayed: NAAR CENTRAAL. On the next: TE LAAT.
The Singel, black. Across it, the flower market's stalls rock on their pontoons, their bulbs still lit.
